name: hashmap-heap
algorithm: Hash map churn with each language's standard map on its default general-purpose heap/GC allocator (no arena in any column), u64 keys: n splitmix64-mixed keys inserted from empty, hit+miss lookups, every other key removed, re-probed; rounds times with a fresh map (README.md).

skip.c: no std hash map in C
skip.mk-wrap: the checksum already uses the wrapping operators; there is no checked arithmetic to remove

no_counts: B24 does not apply: an idiomatic row compares libraries, each with its own map; the checksum verifies identical key sets
notes: Default-allocator companion to idiomatic/hashmap: every language allocates its hash map on its default general-purpose heap/GC allocator (Mk HeapMap on sys.heap, Zig AutoHashMap on init.gpa, Rust HashMap on global allocator, Go map, C# Dictionary), with no arena in any column.

Hashes and DoS posture: mk HeapMap.New (DD-5 fixed), mk-keyed HeapMap.NewKeyed (SipHash-1-3 random key), Rust HashMap (SipHash-1-3 RandomState), Zig AutoHashMap (wyhash seed 0), Go map (AES seeded per map), C# Dictionary<ulong, ulong> (ulong.GetHashCode(), fixed).
